#!/usr/bin/env node 'use strict'; /** * A demo class. * @param {string} name the name * @returns {Demo} */ class Demo extends Base { #count = 42; constructor(name) { super(); this.name = name; } get label() { return `demo ${this.name}`; } set label(value) { this.name = value; } async run(items) { // a line comment /* a block comment */ const ratio = 1.5e-3; const hex = 0x1f, bin = 0b1010, big = 123n; const re = /[a-z]+\/[0-9]{2}/gi; const arrow = (a, b) => a + b; const obj = { name: 'pier', count: hex, nested: { ok: true } }; const [first, ...rest] = items; const html = html`<div class="box">${this.name}</div>`; const css = css`.box { color: #fff; }`; if (this.#count > 0 && rest.length) { console.log(html, css, ratio, bin, big, re, arrow(1, 2), obj, first); } return <Box name={this.name} count={this.#count} />; } } function helper(a, b) { return a * b; } const fn = function named(x) { return x; }; export default Demo;
